The teacher, Mr. Ali, stands at the front, his eyes twinkling with a mix of amusement and a hint of pride. He clears his throat and begins, “Today, we have a special guest among us—Erdem, our chemistry whiz from Istanbul! While Erdem shines like a reagent in perfect solution, let’s take a moment to reflect on our international friends. Have you ever noticed how some students seem to arrive right on time, as if they were scheduled for a lab appointment? That’s right, our punctual friends from Germany. They’re so reliable, one might mistake them for a stable isotope! But remember, here in Turkey, we roll with the chaos and still manage to extract pure solutions every time.”
